description: A project's settings file: settings that do not touch the check set, and settings that only add to it (ADR-094). Generated by `settings_lint.schema()`; do not edit by hand.

acceptance_strategy.description: Whether the four-layer acceptance strategy (`S17`) is on for the project: `state` is `on` or `off`, and `off` needs a `reason`, which assess records. Unset means on; only the project's own file can hold it.

reason.description: Why the project turned the strategy off. Required with `off`.

adoption.description: Whether a failed check blocks: `enforced` makes `compass check` and `compass ci` exit non-zero, and `advisory` reports the failure and exits 0. The shipped default is `enforced`.

agent_review.description: Turns on the advisory judged check `agent-review` at the `ship` stage (ADR-090 decision 7). `on` or `true` turns it on, and `off` or `false` leaves the default, which is off.

oneOf.description: `true` turns the check on and `false` leaves it off.
`on` turns the check on and `off` leaves it off.

allow_project_commands.description: Whether `compass check` may run commands that a project guardrail declares, read from the project's own file only. The default is `false`.

approvers.description: Lists of the people who may approve a waiver, by kind.

issue-waiver.description: The names that may approve a waiver in an issue, read as `waiver` from 9.0.0 when that list is absent. When both are absent, the owner approves.

waiver.description: The names that may approve a waiver of one check on one issue (ADR-094). When absent, issue-waiver is read; when both are absent, the owner approves.

autonomy.description: How often a session stops for a person at a stage hand-off: `controlled` at every listed hand-off, `balanced` at fewer, `autonomous` never. The shipped default is `balanced`.

capabilities.description: Named switches for new blocking behavior. Each is off in the shipped default.

entry-exit-evaluation.description: Whether the entry and exit checks of each stage are evaluated. Off in the shipped default.

enforcement.description: Extra paths the pre-tool hook guards. Holds `code_globs`, a list of path patterns the hook treats as code.

governance_drift.description: Whether drift from the shipped governance fails: `strict` fails `compass policy lint` and `advisory` only reports it. The default is `advisory`.

language.description: The language of the prose an agent writes, as a BCP 47 tag: a language, an optional script and an optional region, joined by hyphens, such as `en-US`. Unset: no instruction; only the project's own `compass.yml` can hold it, never a parent, a preset or an issue.

owner.description: The name of the person who owns the project's configuration. The owner approves waivers unless a list of approvers says otherwise.

project.description: The project's name, its commands (`test_command`, `test_micro_command`, `bdd_run_command` and `layering_command`, which `compass layering record` runs when given no command), and the paths of its acceptance support code (`acceptance_support`). Since 9.0.0 (ADR-093) nothing reads `lint_command`, `format_check_command`, `build_command`, `typecheck_command`, `secret_scan` or `structured_logging`, which stay valid and which `compass policy lint` names.

acceptance_support.description: The paths of the support code of the four-layer acceptance strategy (`S17`), each relative to the project root. `acceptance-support-present` reports a piece with no path, or a path that does not exist, as missing; it opens no file and blocks nothing.

alias_helper.description: The path of the alias helper, which makes each identifier a scenario uses unique to the run.

driver_factory.description: The path of the driver factory, which picks the protocol driver at start-up.

dsl_root.description: The path of the root of the domain-specific language the specifications call.

layering_test.description: The path of the layering test, which checks that each test layer calls only the layer below it.

project_checks.description: The project's own checks, each a command that must exit 0. `compass check` runs one only when `allow_project_commands` is `true`.

items.description: One project check: its `id`, `name`, `command`, `stage` and an optional `when`.

command.description: The command `compass check` runs from the project root; exit 0 passes.

id.description: The check's id, which must not be the id of a shipped check or gate, or of a check Compass deleted.

stage.description: The stage the check is cleared at: `build` or `ship`.

when.description: A condition on the assessment under which the check applies. Absent, it applies to every issue that ships.

record.description: Where the delivery record is kept, with `remote`, `paths` and `names_key`, and whether each issue's record is committed with its code (`commit`). Without `remote` no record repository is kept.

commit.description: `true` commits each issue's record with its code and `false` keeps it out of the project's git history. Unset, the record is committed unless `remote` is set.

require_evidence.description: More evidence a delivery issue owes when its assessment matches. Each entry adds tokens and never removes one.

items.description: One rule: the assessment it applies to (`when`) and the tokens it adds (`add`).

add.description: The evidence tokens the rule adds, from the closed set the evidence rows use.

when.description: A condition on the assessment, such as `risk: [critical]` or `labels_any: [billing]`. Absent or empty, the rule applies to every delivery issue.

schema.description: The version of the file format. Its presence also marks `compass.yml` as Compass's file.

signoff_labels.description: More labels that owe what the four shipped `G5` labels owe: a person's sign-off (`human-approval`) and approved scenarios (`scenario-approval`). It only adds to `auth`, `payments`, `personal-data` and `migrations`.

items.description: One label name, as an assessment writes it.

title: compass.yml
